class TestRunmode(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_runmode_reports_state(self):
        import cli
        result = cli.handle_runmode({"role": "admin"})
        self.assertTrue(result["ok"])
        self.assertIn("run mode", result["message"])

    def test_runmode_denied(self):
        import cli
        result = cli.handle_runmode({"role": "guest"})
        self.assertFalse(result["ok"])
        self.assertEqual(result["message"], "denied")
